purpose: Define provider-independent project events and separate non-authoritative forge observations so AXIOM collaboration, release, CI, security, policy, and artifact history can survive provider loss without making a forge the durable identity or authority.
core_invariants: A forge may host project state; it does not define the durable identity of an AXIOM project object or event.
A provider observation may establish provenance and availability; it does not create governance authority.
External account identity is not AXIOM actor identity without an explicit verified binding.
Private or sensitive project content is never required to be retained inline in a portable event.
claim_boundary: This contract does not scrape, import, export, or mutate any forge.
This contract does not independently verify provider API authenticity or actor bindings.
This contract does not make a CI pass a capability promotion or a review a governance approval.
This contract does not yet persist project events in Grid or restore them into another forge.
